contradictions.explanation: With only three shifts and three people each pair working a different shift from the others, each person must occupy a distinct shift, which is possible in principle but is contradicted by the narrative showing Yara and Bo together at the finish line and Finn and Dev together comparing notes, implying overlapping presence inconsistent with all three being on strictly different shifts.
